description: Pre-execution transaction safety check for autonomous AI agents from the SENTINEL trust oracle (sentinel-agent.dev). Before signing an on-chain transaction on Base, an agent gets a SAFE / UNSAFE / UNKNOWN verdict, a SENTINEL Score (0-100, AAA-D), and an ed25519-signed receipt. Pay-per-call via x402.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
